integrity: Theorem, proof, numerical values and checker concern the same two fixed wildcard positions. The literature comparison supports a qualified, not independently verified, novelty assessment.
scientific_limitations: Binary linear words, exactly one wildcard in position one or two; no counts for other positions or cyclic words. All-order proof uses the published forced-prefix lemma; finite scripts are supporting checks.
title: Exact counts of one-wildcard binary universal partial words at the first two positions
